mentions.note: one of the supporters without whom the 'Bells' would have faded out

photos.caption: This photograph of a winning team of Belgravians was taken long long ago, but who are they? Three only of the seven shown can be identified, A.G. BOOL (2nd left), F.A. BOOL (2nd right) and A.P. FLETCHER (seated left).
